yaml_format.recursive_key_order: case-insensitive-primary locale-independent lexical with original-value tie-break
yaml_format.string_list_rule: sort all-string lists except ordered-list keys
yaml_format.record_list_rule: sort recognized mapping-record lists by registry stable fields; preserve unrecognized object/mixed lists and ordered-list keys
yaml_format.scalar_policy: preserve string, boolean, number, and null types
yaml_format.opaque_block_policy: preserve block-scalar bodies and IMPL pseudo-code sidecars
